note: Canonical Git-controlled copy of the two live resume standards, verbatim. This record adds no new rule and no new architecture; it names the exact standard versions the normal operating lane uses. It never changes Candidate Truth, Match Truth, Pursuit Truth, identity semantics, immigration logic or submission authority.

RESUME_CONTENT_STANDARD_V1.text: Every experience section must prioritize recruiter-readable business/process impact over internal implementation detail; where verified evidence supports it, at least one bullet should state the outcome, risk reduced, time/quality/process improvement, or decision value created by the work.
RESUME_CONTENT_STANDARD_V1.truth_clause: Preserve truth. Never invent impact metrics or unsupported outcomes.
RESUME_CONTENT_STANDARD_V1.enforcement: Candidate Truth claim lineage and number-grounding in src/gold_resume_qa.py (check_lineage) plus HUMAN_REQUIRED review, assisted by the claim_wording_review.json artifact. Impact emphasis is a model/authoring standard, not an automated gate.

RESUME_FORMAT_STANDARD_V1.intro: Use the approved Gold presentation mechanics:
mechanics: Education school + right-aligned date on the same paragraph using a right tab stop;
Work Experience Title | Employer + right-aligned date using a right tab stop;
preserve one-page Gold section order, typography hierarchy, rules, hyperlinks and ≥92% utilization floor.
RESUME_FORMAT_STANDARD_V1.enforcement: src/gold_resume_docx_builder.py (generation) and src/gold_resume_qa.py (pre-render grammar checks NAME_CENTERED_BOLD_SIZE, CONTACT_LINE_GRAMMAR, SUMMARY_PRESENT_NO_HEADING incl. centered summary, EDUCATION_GRAMMAR, WORK_HEADER_TITLE_PIPE_EMPLOYER_RIGHT_DATE; post-render one-page Letter, link parity and the 0.92 floor).
